title: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche aims to be an innovation accelerator in China, collaborating with partners to jointly develop and deliver novel therapies for patients across the world. This effort is designed to expand and deepen their collective impact on patient health. The global I2CVRM Search & Evaluation (S&E) team, a component of Corporate Business Development (CBD), is focused on identifying and securing external innovation opportunities that strategically align with the Immunology & Infectious Diseases (I2) and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) Therapeutic Areas (TAs). This involves active engagement with the external innovation community, including academic institutions, venture capital firms, Roche Accelerator, KoL, PI and the startup biotech ecosystem. The S&E team works collaboratively with internal teams (e.g. Asian partnering team) to advance opportunities from initial identification and incubation through to pre-due diligence. A key function is translating the I2CVRM TA's end-to-end strategy (DAS) into regional sourcing and activation plans designed to bring high-impact science into our pipeline. We are looking to partner with pharma and biotech in China. Currently, the global I2CVRM S&E team has one Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead CVRM opportunity available in Shanghai . The Opportunity The CVRM S&E China Strategy Lead will be responsible for proactively shaping and nurturing key relationships and stakeholders (prioritized academic research centers, Roche accelerator, venture capital investors, life science and health technology incubators and start-ups) to ensure Roche is perceived as a “Partner of Choice” in their respective regions. This leader will also work closely with the global S&E I2CVRM team & local Asian partnering team, to scout, triage and conduct early evaluations activities to understand the true value of further pursuit through provision of scientific expertise. This role reports to the Global Head I2CVRM S&E who is based in Basel (CH). Responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to the following:
• External Search: to cover the China CVRM landscape, to partner closely with the Global S&E Head to set the sourcing strategy and engagement plan aligned with the TA end to end strategy & CBD priorities
• To lead the triage process and work closely with TA partners and CBD colleagues to conduct initial evaluations and ensure alignment with our strategic focus. To provide scientific thought leadership and analysis in initial scientific review.
• The S&E China CVRM Strategy Lead will maintain overall oversight of S&E CVRM activities in China, with the autonomy to delegate specific landscaping, scouting or evaluation tasks to CBD team members (e.g. BDPLs from Asia partnering team) as appropriate.
• Building close relationships with relevant Roche & Genentech businesses. This is to both understand/contribute to strategy/requirements and to develop sufficient influence in order to champion new opportunities, including those that are potentially “off strategy” but where a compelling business case can be made.
• Supports the transition of identified opportunities to the Due Diligence phase via collaboration and transfer of background and scientific context to a BDPL
• Serves as an ambassador for CBD internally and externally at industry events
• The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list, and you may be required to undertake any other reasonable duties compatible with your experience and competencies.
